description: Apply the Brain OS policy table to a risk assessment. Takes the output of risk_assess plus the concrete action type and returns a policy decision: allow (proceed), ask (stop and get explicit user confirmation), block (do not proceed), or not_assessed (no rule covered the action: Brain OS has no opinion, which is not approval; fall back to your own judgment and your host's confirmation rules). Pure TypeScript — no LLM call. Policies in order: private_to_public → block; critical risk → block; force-push → ask; npm publish → ask; security boundary → ask; irreversible → ask; high risk → ask; hard-to-reverse external → ask; medium + requires_confirmation → ask; not assessed → not_assessed; else → allow. Always audit what was decided and why.

action_type.description: The concrete action being guarded, e.g. 'npm publish', 'git push origin main', 'force push', 'write ROADMAP.md'.

entity_id.description: Brain OS entity this action is associated with.

name: action_guard
